出生地: 美国,华盛顿哥伦比亚特区
简介: Moses Goods was born in 1977. He is an actor, known for Hae Hawaii (2018), Inhumans (2017) and Stones (2009). Moses is also a prominent stage actor and playwright based in Hawaii and wrote a one-man-show entitled "DUKE" about the legendary surfer and Olympian Duke Kahanamoku. Moses is from the island of Maui in Hawaii and is of Black and Native Hawaiian ancestry.
